analysis: The supplied units are base-side excerpts of docs/developer/test.md. The patch is documentation only: it changes the 'Last updated' date, adds a Gemma routed-expert placement check description (GemmaRoutedExpertChecks, line 28 onward), and amends the Gemma 4 pipeline lanes wording near base 1873 and head 1878. No code, configuration, protocol, key handling, attestation, authorization, cache-storage or workflow behavior changes. The retained base text shown (App Attest dispatch, native serving qualification, SSD write-budget and cache gates, release workflow tests, cluster checks) describes existing test procedures. I found nothing that weakens T-041 (prefix-cache / SSD tier), the TB-011 App Attest authorization boundary, or the release/signing controls. The doc keeps the language that local fixture and loopback passes do not count as physical Apple or two-Mac qualification, and that no backend checkout is part of the public gate. I did not see the tail of the patch excerpt (it is truncated at 'Actual '), nor the head-side text for the later changed ranges (head 2229-2246). Those hunks are probably further doc edits, but I could not verify them. A final pass should confirm they contain no weakened qualification claims. No finding qualifies.
